posts.title: Take no hint: soundness vulnerability in gnark zk-SNARK library
posts.description: How a missing on-curve constraint in fake GLV scalar multiplication allowed ECDSA signature forgery in zk-SNARK circuits.

posts.title: Keep It Like a Secret: Finality and trust in commit-reveal protocols
posts.description: "Trustless" bridges claim to allow secure asset exchange across chains even in the presence of malicious actors. However, we argue that truly trustless protocols based on commit-reveal schemes are actually impossible when at least one of the participants does not wait for block finality.

posts.title: Subtleties of BLS Signatures
posts.description: This article explores an observation in the use of BLS signature aggregation within a production blockchain.
